item.title: Plankton hold the secrets of the ocean in their shells
item.description: An international research team led by the University of Galway has found a new way to learn about ocean acidity and CO2 levels using plankton. item.title: Galway medtech company gets EU regulatory approval for Vein Infusion device
item.description: InVera Medical, a Galway based medtech company, has received European regulatory approval for a new minimally invasive device designed to help physicians deliver treatment more effectively to diseased leg veins, including varicose veins.
